source_refs.note: Roman Urdu: practice short questions written from Chapter 7 (PDF 139-173), not printed in the book; same questions and order as the English set. Drafts needing academic review.

blocks.text: Yeh chapter 7 (Waves and Vibrations) ke poore chapter se practice short questions (mukhtasar sawal) hain, chapter ke sections ki tarteeb mein, Board ke 2 number wale sawal ke andaz mein. Har sawal ka mukhtasar model jawab hai; chhote numericals mein hal ke qadam hain, aur farq wale sawal ka jawab table mein hai.

blocks.prompt:
1 What is a wave? Give one example of energy transfer by waves.
(Wave (lehar) kya hai? Waves ke zariye energy muntaqil hone ki aik misaal dein.)
blocks.explanation: Wave aik baqaida khalal (disturbance) hai jo energy le kar source se phailti hai. Misaal: Sooraj ki energy light waves (electromagnetic waves) ke zariye vacuum se guzar kar Zameen tak aati hai.

book_ref.quote: A wave is a regular disturbance or variation that carries energy

blocks.prompt:
2 When a stone is dropped into a pond, does the water move outward with the ripple? Explain.
(Talaab mein pathar girane par kya paani ripple ke saath bahar ki taraf chala jata hai? Wazahat karein.)
blocks.explanation: Nahi. Pathar aik khalal (ripple) paida karta hai jo paani mein aage barhta hai. Paani ke zarraat sirf apni jagah oopar neeche hilte hain; pattern (wave) aur us ki energy aage phailti hai.

book_ref.quote: The stone produces a disturbance (ripple) that travels through the water (medium).

blocks.prompt:
3 Define amplitude and wavelength of a wave.
(Wave ke amplitude aur wavelength ki definition likhein.)
blocks.explanation:
Amplitude (A): equilibrium position se wave (ya zarraat) ka zyada se zyada displacement.
Wavelength (λ): wave par do lagataar milte julte, aik phase wale points ka faasla.

book_ref.quote: Amplitude (A): The maximum displacement of the wave

blocks.prompt:
4 Define the period of a wave. Find the period of a wave of frequency 50 Hz.
(Wave ke period ki definition likhein. 50 Hz frequency wali wave ka period nikalein.)
blocks.explanation:
Period (T) woh waqt hai jis mein wave aik oscillation (cycle) poora kare; yeh frequency ka ulat hai.
T = 1/f = 1/50 = 0.02 s

book_ref.quote: Period (T): The time taken by the wave to complete one oscillation or cycle.

blocks.prompt:
5 Show that the speed of a wave is v = fλ.
(Sabit karein ke wave ki speed v = fλ hai.)
blocks.explanation: Crest aik period T mein aik wavelength λ chalti hai, is liye v = faasla/waqt = λ/T. Chunke 1/T = f, v = fλ (Eq. 7.1).

book_ref.quote: If a wave crest moves one wavelength λ in one period of oscillation T

blocks.prompt:
6 A tuning fork of frequency 256 Hz produces sound of wavelength 1.3 m in air. Find the speed of sound.
(256 Hz frequency ka tuning fork hawa mein 1.3 m wavelength ki sound banata hai. Sound ki speed nikalein.)

book_ref.quote: 5. Speed (v): The speed at which the wave travels.

blocks.prompt:
7 Define a transverse wave and give an example from the chapter.
(Transverse wave ki definition likhein aur chapter se aik misaal dein.)
blocks.explanation: Transverse wave woh hai jis mein zarraat ki vibration energy ke safar ki simt ke amoodi (90°) ho. Misaal: visible light (chapter ki tasweeri muqabla mein transverse wave).

book_ref.quote: A transverse wave is one in which the vibrations of the particles are at right angle

blocks.prompt:
8 Define a longitudinal wave and give an example from the chapter.
(Longitudinal wave ki definition likhein aur chapter se aik misaal dein.)
blocks.explanation: Longitudinal wave woh hai jis mein zarraat ki vibration energy ke safar ki simt ke saath (mutawazi) ho. Misaal: sound waves (maslan organ pipe ke hawa ke column mein).

book_ref.quote: the direction of the vibration of the particles is along or parallel to

blocks.prompt:
9 Differentiate between mechanical waves and electromagnetic waves.
(Mechanical waves aur electromagnetic waves mein farq bayan karein.)
blocks.explanation: Mechanical waves ko medium chahiye; electromagnetic waves ko nahi, woh vacuum mein bhi chalti hain.

book_ref.quote: These waves require a physical medium (solid, liquid, or gas) to propagate.

rows: Phailne ke liye maaddi medium (solid, liquid, gas) chahiye.
Phailne ke liye medium nahi chahiye.
Vacuum (khala) mein nahi chal sakteen.
Vacuum mein chal sakti hain.
Misalein: paani ki waves, sound waves, seismic waves.
Misalein: radiowaves, microwaves, visible light, X-rays, gamma rays.

blocks.prompt:
10 What are quantum waves and surface waves? Give one example of each.
(Quantum waves aur surface waves kya hain? Har aik ki aik misaal dein.)
blocks.explanation:
Quantum waves electrons aur photons jaise zarraat se wabasta hain, maslan atoms mein electrons ki matter (de-Broglie) waves.
Surface waves do mediums ki sath ya sarhad ke saath chalti hain, maslan hawa se banne wali samandar ki sath ki waves.

book_ref.quote: Quantum waves are associated with particles like electrons and photons.

blocks.prompt:
11 State the principle of superposition of waves for n waves.
(n waves ke liye superposition ke usool ko bayan karein.)
blocks.explanation:
Agar medium ke zarre par aik saath n waves amal karein jo y₁, y₂, …, yₙ displacements dein, to resultant displacement in ka algebraic majmua hai:
y = y₁ + y₂ + … + yₙ

book_ref.quote: If a particle of the medium is simultaneously acted upon by two waves

blocks.prompt:
12 Two waves give displacements of 6 mm and 4 mm at a point. Find the resultant displacement when they are (i) in the same phase (ii) in opposite phase.
(Do waves aik point par 6 mm aur 4 mm displacement deti hain. Resultant displacement nikalein jab woh (i) aik phase mein hon (ii) ulat phase mein hon.)
blocks.explanation:
(i) Aik phase: y = 6 + 4 = 10 mm
(ii) Ulat phase: y = 6 − 4 = 2 mm

book_ref.quote: (i) If two waves, which overlap each other, have same phase

blocks.prompt:
13 Name the three phenomena that result from superposition of waves and state the condition for each.
(Waves ke superposition se hone wale teen mazahir (phenomena) ke naam aur un ki shart likhein.)
blocks.explanation:
1. Interference: aik frequency, aik simt wali do waves.
2. Beats: thori mukhtalif frequencies, aik simt wali do waves.
3. Stationary waves: barabar frequency, ulat simton wali do waves.

book_ref.quote: Principle of superposition of waves leads to many interesting phenomena:

blocks.prompt:
14 What is the "anti-noise" signal in noise-cancelling headphones, and why does it reduce noise?
(Noise-cancelling headphones mein "anti-noise" signal kya hai aur yeh shor kyun kam karta hai?)
blocks.explanation: Processing unit aik anti-noise signal banata hai jo amplitude aur phase mein maahol ke shor ka bilkul ulat hai. Jab yeh shor se milta hai to superposition se dono khatam ho jaate hain aur shor bohat kam sunayi deta hai.

book_ref.quote: The processing unit generates an "anti-noise" signal

blocks.prompt:
15 To which waves does the principle of superposition apply? What does y(x,t) represent?
(Superposition ka usool kin waves par laagu hota hai? y(x,t) kya zahir karta hai?)
blocks.explanation: Yeh linear waves, yani chhote amplitude wali waves par laagu hota hai. y(x,t) wave function hai: point x aur waqt t par resultant displacement, jo wave ki shakal aur waqt ke saath tabdeeli batata hai.

book_ref.quote: the principle of superposition applies to linear waves, that is, waves of small amplitude

blocks.prompt:
16 Define interference of waves.
(Waves ke interference (mudakhilat) ki definition likhein.)
blocks.explanation: Aik hi frequency wali, aik hi simt mein chalti do waves ka superposition interference kehlata hai.

book_ref.quote: Superposition of two waves having the same frequency and travelling in the same direction

blocks.prompt:
17 What are the roles of the audio generator, the microphone and the CRO in the interference experiment for sound?
(Sound ke interference tajurbe mein audio generator, microphone aur CRO ka kya kaam hai?)
blocks.explanation: Audio generator dono speakers S₁, S₂ ko aik fixed frequency par (aik phase mein) chalata hai. Microphone mukhtalif points par sound pakarta hai. CRO microphone ka signal waveform ki shakal mein dikhata hai: bara ya sifr displacement.

book_ref.quote: A microphone attached to a sensitive Cathode Ray Oscilloscope (CRO) acts as a detector of sound waves.

blocks.prompt:
18 Write the condition for constructive interference. What is seen on the CRO at such a point?
(Constructive interference ki shart likhein. Aise point par CRO par kya nazar aata hai?)
blocks.explanation: Path difference wavelength ka poora multiple ho: ΔS = nλ, n = 0, ±1, ±2, … Wahan compression compression se milta hai aur CRO par bara displacement nazar aata hai.

book_ref.quote: Whenever the path difference is an integral multiple of wavelength

blocks.prompt:
19 Write the condition for destructive interference. What is seen on the CRO at such a point?
(Destructive interference ki shart likhein. Aise point par CRO par kya nazar aata hai?)
blocks.explanation: Path difference λ/2 ka taaq (odd) multiple ho: ΔS = (2n + 1)λ/2. Wahan compression rarefaction se milta hai aur CRO par sifr displacement.

book_ref.quote: the path difference is an odd integral multiple of half the wavelength

blocks.prompt:
20 Two coherent speakers emit sound of wavelength 0.50 m. A point is 3.0 m from one speaker and 4.25 m from the other. Is the sound loud or faint there?
(Do coherent speakers 0.50 m wavelength ki sound dete hain. Aik point aik speaker se 3.0 m aur doosre se 4.25 m door hai. Wahan aawaz oonchi hai ya dheemi?)
blocks.explanation: ΔS = 4.25 − 3.0 = 1.25 m = 2.5λ = (2×2 + 1)λ/2, yani λ/2 ka odd multiple. Destructive interference: dheemi (na hone ke barabar) aawaz.

book_ref.quote: The path difference ΔS between the waves at points P₂ and P₄, is

blocks.prompt:
21 Two speakers 1.5 m apart emit a tone of 680 Hz. A microphone 2.0 m directly opposite one speaker is at the first loud point next to the centre. Find the speed of sound.
(1.5 m door do speakers 680 Hz ki tone dete hain. Aik speaker ke bilkul saamne 2.0 m par microphone markaz ke baad pehle oonchi aawaz wale point par hai. Sound ki speed nikalein.)

book_ref.quote: For the next point P of constructive interference, the path difference between waves should be λ.

blocks.prompt:
22 What are stationary waves? How are they formed?
(Stationary waves kya hain? Yeh kaise banti hain?)
blocks.explanation: Stationary (standing) waves aik jagah oscillate karti hain, aage nahi barhteen. Yeh aik frequency aur amplitude wali do ulat simt mein chalti waves ke superposition se banti hain, maslan string par waves, pipe mein sound.

book_ref.quote: Stationary waves, also known as standing waves, are the waves that oscillate in a fixed position

blocks.prompt:
23 Define node and antinode. How far apart are they?
(Node aur antinode ki definition likhein. Un ka aapas mein faasla kitna hota hai?)
blocks.explanation:
Nodes: jahan resultant displacement hamesha sifr ho. Antinodes: jo zyada se zyada amplitude (dono amplitudes ka majmua) se hilte hain, nodes ke beech mein.
Node se node = λ/2; antinode se antinode = λ/2; node se agla antinode = λ/4.

book_ref.quote: These points of the medium are known as nodes.

blocks.prompt:
24 Differentiate between progressive waves and stationary waves.
(Progressive waves aur stationary waves mein farq bayan karein.)
blocks.explanation: Progressive wave energy le kar aage barhti hai; stationary wave nodes aur antinodes ke saath aik jagah rehti hai.

book_ref.quote: It is a wave that propagates or moves forward, as opposed to a stationary or standing wave.

rows: Medium mein aik simt mein aage chalti hain.
Aik jagah oscillate karti hain, aage nahi barhteen.
Energy aik jagah se doosri jagah le jaati hain.
Energy nodes ke darmiyan 'khari' rehti hai; nodes se aage nahi jaati.
Aik chalti wave se banti hain.
Aik frequency aur amplitude ki do ulat simt wali waves se banti hain.
Fixed nodes aur antinodes nahi hote.
Nodes aur antinodes apni jagah qaim hote hain.

blocks.prompt:
25 Why does energy not travel along the medium in a stationary wave? In what forms does it exist at the antinodes?
(Stationary wave mein energy medium ke saath aage kyun nahi jaati? Antinodes par yeh kis shakal mein hoti hai?)
blocks.explanation: Energy zarraat ki harkat se chalti hai; nodes hamesha saakin hain, is liye energy un se aage nahi jaati aur nodes ke darmiyan khari rehti hai. Antinodes par intehai displacement par poori potential aur equilibrium se guzarte waqt poori kinetic hoti hai.

book_ref.quote: Hence, energy remains “standing” in the medium between nodes

blocks.prompt:
26 A stationary wave has wavelength 1.2 m. Find the distance between (i) two consecutive nodes (ii) a node and the next antinode.
(Stationary wave ki wavelength 1.2 m hai. Faasla nikalein: (i) do lagataar nodes (ii) node aur agla antinode.)
blocks.explanation:
(i) Node se node = λ/2 = 0.6 m
(ii) Node se agla antinode = λ/4 = 0.3 m

book_ref.quote: It is obvious that the points 1, 2, …, 7 are distant λ/4 apart

blocks.text: 7.5 Stationary waves on a stretched string

blocks.prompt:
27 Why are nodes always formed at the two ends of a stretched string?
(Kasi hui string ke dono siron par hamesha nodes kyun bante hain?)
blocks.explanation: Dono sire kase (clamped) hote hain, is liye wahan koi harkat nahi hoti. Reflect hone wali waves stationary waves banati hain jin ke nodes dono siron par hote hain.

book_ref.quote: As the two ends of the string are clamped, no motion will take place there.

blocks.prompt:
28 On what factors does the speed of transverse waves on a stretched string depend? Write the formula.
(Kasi hui string par transverse waves ki speed kin cheezon par munhasir hai? Formula likhein.)
blocks.explanation: v = √(F/m), jahan F tension aur m string ki fi unit lambai mass hai (Eq. 7.3). Yeh pluck karne ki jagah se aazad hai.

book_ref.quote: The speed v of the waves in the string depends upon the tension F

blocks.prompt:
29 A string 0.60 m long has tension 90 N and mass per unit length 0.025 kg m⁻¹. Find the wave speed and its fundamental frequency.
(0.60 m lambi string ki tension 90 N aur fi unit lambai mass 0.025 kg m⁻¹ hai. Wave speed aur fundamental frequency nikalein.)

book_ref.quote: Substituting the value of v, to get

blocks.prompt:
30 Why does the frequency of a string become double when it is plucked at one quarter of its length?
(String ko chauthai lambai se chherne par us ki frequency dugni kyun ho jati hai?)
blocks.explanation: Chauthai lambai (antinode ki jagah) se chherne par string do loops mein vibrate karti hai, is liye λ₂ = l (2l ke bajaye). Speed v wahi rehti hai, to f₂ = v/l = 2(v/2l) = 2f₁.

book_ref.quote: Thus, when the string vibrates in two loops, its frequency becomes double

blocks.prompt:
31 What is meant by quantization of frequencies on a stretched string?
(Kasi string par frequencies ki quantization se kya muraad hai?)
blocks.explanation: String sirf alag alag frequencies fₙ = nf₁ (n = 1, 2, 3, …) par stationary waves bana sakti hai, darmiyan mein chhalang (quantum jump) hoti hai. Yeh tension, lambai aur fi unit lambai mass se tay hoti hain; baaqi waves jaldi khatam ho jaati hain.

book_ref.quote: In other words, quantum jumps in frequency exist between the resonance frequencies.

blocks.prompt:
32 What are harmonics? Which one is the fundamental?
(Harmonics kya hain? Fundamental kaun sa hai?)
blocks.explanation: Frequencies f₁, 2f₁, 3f₁, …, nf₁ wali tamam mumkin standing waves system ke harmonics hain. Sab se kam f₁ fundamental ya pehla harmonic hai; 2f₁ doosra harmonic, waghaira.

book_ref.quote: In the above example, the set of all the possible standing waves, having frequencies f₁, 2f₁, 3f₁, …, nf₁, are called harmonics

blocks.prompt:
33 How can a guitar player change the frequency of a string?
(Guitar bajane wala string ki frequency kaise badal sakta hai?)
blocks.explanation: (1) Tension badal kar, neck par pegs kas kar. (2) Lambai badal kar: tune hone ke baad ungliyan neck par chala kar thirakne wale hisse ki lambai badal kar.

book_ref.quote: The frequency of a string on a musical instrument can be changed either by varying the tension or by changing the length.

blocks.prompt:
34 A string 2.0 m long, fixed at both ends, vibrates in 4 loops at 200 Hz. Find the wavelength and the fundamental frequency.
(Dono siron se bandhi 2.0 m lambi string 200 Hz par 4 loops mein vibrate karti hai. Wavelength aur fundamental frequency nikalein.)

book_ref.quote: (i) As the string vibrates in four segments and the distance between two consecutive nodes is λ/2

blocks.prompt:
35 What happens to the fundamental frequency of a stretched string if its vibrating length is halved, tension unchanged?
(Agar kasi string ki thirakne wali lambai aadhi kar di jaye aur tension wahi rahe to fundamental frequency par kya asar hoga?)
blocks.explanation: f₁ = (1/2l)√(F/m), yani f₁ ∝ 1/l. Lambai aadhi karne se fundamental frequency dugni ho jati hai (speed v wahi rehti hai).

book_ref.quote: where λ₁ is the wavelength of the waves set up in this mode.

blocks.prompt:
36 What is an organ pipe? Why is its open end an antinode and its closed end a node?
(Organ pipe kya hai? Is ka khula sira antinode aur band sira node kyun hota hai?)
blocks.explanation: Organ pipe hawa ka saaz hai: aik khokhli lambi tube (dono sire khule ya aik band) jis mein hawa ke column ki stationary waves se sound banti hai. Khule sire par molecules poori tarah aazad (antinode); band sire par un ki harkat ruki (node).

book_ref.quote: It consists of a hollow long tube with both ends open or with one end open and the other closed.

blocks.prompt:
37 Differentiate between an organ pipe open at both ends and one closed at one end.
(Dono siron se khuli aur aik sire se band organ pipe mein farq bayan karein.)
blocks.explanation: Khuli pipe ke dono siron par antinodes aur tamam harmonics; band pipe ke band sire par node aur sirf odd harmonics.

book_ref.quote: Then at the closed end, we get a node while at the open end, we get an antinode

rows: Dono siron par antinodes.
Band sire par node, khule sire par antinode.
Fundamental: l = λ₁/2, λ₁ = 2l, f₁ = v/2l.
Fundamental: l = λ₁/4, λ₁ = 4l, f₁ = v/4l.
fₙ = nf₁, n = 1, 2, 3, … (tamam harmonics).
fₙ = nf₁, n = 1, 3, 5, … (sirf odd harmonics).
Harmonics mein zyada amir.
Kam harmonics.

blocks.prompt:
38 A pipe 0.68 m long is open at both ends. Find its fundamental frequency and second harmonic (speed of sound 340 m s⁻¹).
(0.68 m lambi pipe dono siron se khuli hai. Us ki fundamental frequency aur doosra harmonic nikalein (sound ki speed 340 m s⁻¹).)

book_ref.quote: Let us consider an organ pipe of length l which is open at both ends.

blocks.prompt:
39 The same 0.68 m pipe is now closed at one end. Find its fundamental frequency and the next harmonic (speed of sound 340 m s⁻¹).
(Wahi 0.68 m pipe ab aik sire se band hai. Us ki fundamental frequency aur agla harmonic nikalein (sound ki speed 340 m s⁻¹).)
blocks.explanation:
f₁ = v/4l = 340/2.72 = 125 Hz
Agla (sirf odd harmonics): f₃ = 3f₁ = 375 Hz

book_ref.quote: If λ₁ is the wavelength of fundamental mode then length of the pipe is:

blocks.prompt:
40 The second mode of a pipe closed at one end has frequency 3f₁. Is it the second or third harmonic? Explain.
(Aik sire se band pipe ke doosre mode ki frequency 3f₁ hai. Kya yeh doosra harmonic hai ya teesra? Wazahat karein.)
blocks.explanation: Yeh teesra harmonic hai kyunke harmonic number f/f₁ = 3 hai. Yeh vibration ka doosra mode hai; band pipe mein sirf odd harmonics (f₁, 3f₁, 5f₁, …) hote hain, doosra harmonic hota hi nahi.

book_ref.quote: It is the second mode of vibration of a pipe closed at one end, which has only odd harmonics

blocks.title: Wazahat
blocks.text: Mode aur harmonic alag cheezein hain. Mode ginti hai (pehla, doosra, teesra pattern), harmonic number f/f₁ hai. Band pipe mein modes ki frequencies f₁, 3f₁, 5f₁ hain, is liye doosre mode ka harmonic number 3 hai.

blocks.prompt:
41 Why is a pipe open at both ends richer in harmonics than a pipe closed at one end?
(Dono siron se khuli pipe aik sire se band pipe se harmonics mein zyada amir kyun hai?)
blocks.explanation: Khuli pipe fₙ = nf₁, n = 1, 2, 3, … (tamam harmonics) de sakti hai, jab ke band pipe ke band sire par node hota hai aur woh sirf n = 1, 3, 5, … (odd harmonics) deti hai.

book_ref.quote: By studying both cases, we conclude that the pipe which is open at both ends is richer in harmonics

blocks.text: 7.7 Experiment demonstrating stationary waves using microwaves

blocks.prompt:
42 Why are microwaves called "micro" waves? When do they form stationary waves in a cavity?
(Microwaves ko "micro" kyun kehte hain? Cavity mein yeh stationary waves kab banati hain?)
blocks.explanation: Un ki wavelengths millimetres ya centimetres ke darje ki hain, radiowaves se bohat chhoti. Wave guide ya resonant chamber mein yeh aage peeche takrati hain aur jab microwave frequency cavity ki resonant frequency se mile to standing wave (nodes, antinodes) banti hai.

book_ref.quote: Microwaves are a form of electromagnetic radiations.

blocks.prompt:
43 How are stationary microwaves produced and detected in the laboratory?
(Laboratory mein stationary microwaves kaise banayi aur pakri jaati hain?)
blocks.explanation: Microwave transmitter, probe detector aur metal reflector aik line mein rakhe jaate hain. Transmitter ki waves metal plate se reflect hoti hain; incident aur reflected waves mil kar stationary wave banati hain. Darmiyan mein probe detector hila kar signal ki intensity se nodes aur antinodes dhoonde jaate hain.

book_ref.quote: This can be detected by a probe detector placed between transmitter and metallic plate.

blocks.prompt:
44 In a microwave experiment, adjacent antinodes are found 2.0 cm apart. Find the wavelength and frequency of the microwaves (c = 3 × 10⁸ m s⁻¹).
(Microwave tajurbe mein saath saath antinodes 2.0 cm door milte hain. Microwaves ki wavelength aur frequency nikalein (c = 3 × 10⁸ m s⁻¹).)
blocks.explanation:
Antinode se antinode = λ/2, is liye λ = 4.0 cm = 0.040 m
f = c/λ = 3 × 10⁸/0.040 = 7.5 × 10⁹ Hz

book_ref.quote: You can move the plate or detector to observe antinode and node.

blocks.prompt:
45 How does the wavelength affect the amount of diffraction through a slit?
(Slit se guzarte waqt wavelength diffraction ki miqdaar par kya asar daalti hai?)
blocks.explanation: Diffraction tab numaya hai jab slit wavelength ke qareeb size ki ho. Jitni lambi wavelength, utna zyada phailao; chhoti wavelength usi slit se kam phailti hai.

book_ref.quote: The longer the wavelength, the greater the spreading and vice versa.

blocks.prompt:
46 Why are X-rays diffracted by crystals?
(X-rays crystals se diffract kyun hoti hain?)
blocks.explanation: Crystal mein atoms ki baqaida qataaron ka faasla X-ray wavelength ke darje ka hota hai. Wavelength ke barabar opening se diffraction hota hai, is liye crystals X-rays ko diffract karte hain.

book_ref.quote: Diffraction of X-rays by crystals as the spacing between the regular arrays of atoms

blocks.prompt:
47 Name the main parts of a ripple tank and the wave properties it can demonstrate.
(Ripple tank ke ahem hisson ke naam aur woh kaun si wave properties dikha sakta hai, likhein.)
blocks.explanation: Hisse: paani, vibrator (maslan motor wali hilti sui), rukawatein (chhota block ya adh-daairi barrier) aur mukhtalif chaurai ke gaps. Yeh paani ki waves ka reflection, diffraction aur refraction dikhata hai.

book_ref.quote: Ripple tank contains water, vibrator (e.g. a motorized oscillating needle)

blocks.prompt:
48 In a ripple tank, what happens to the waves when the gap width is increased compared with the wavelength?
(Ripple tank mein jab gap ki chaurai wavelength ke muqable mein barha di jaye to waves ke saath kya hota hai?)
blocks.explanation: Diffraction kam ho jata hai: waves gap se kam mur kar guzarti hain. Chhote gap par diffraction zyada hota hai aur waves adh-daairi (semicircular) pattern mein phailti hain.

book_ref.quote: As the gap width increases relative to wavelength, diffraction decreases

blocks.prompt:
49 A ripple tank vibrator produces 150 pulses in 5 s. Find the frequency and the period of the pulses.
(Ripple tank ka vibrator 5 s mein 150 pulses banata hai. Pulses ki frequency aur period nikalein.)

50 Why does a compact disc show coloured lanes in white light?
(Compact disc safed roshni mein rangeen lakeerein kyun dikhati hai?)
blocks.explanation: Is ki barik lakeerein (har aik 0.5 μm) diffraction grating ka kaam karti hain. In se diffract hone wali safed roshni rangeen lakeerein banati hai.

book_ref.quote: When a small source of white light illuminates a disc

blocks.prompt:
51 Define beats. How many beats per second are heard from two sources?
(Beats ki definition likhein. Do sources se fi second kitne beats sunayi dete hain?)
blocks.explanation: Jab thori mukhtalif frequencies wali do aik simt mein chalti waves milti hain to aawaz ka baqaida zyada aur kam hona beats kehlata hai. Fi second beats = dono frequencies ka farq.

book_ref.quote: there is a periodic variation of sound between maximum and minimum loudness which is called as beats

blocks.prompt:
52 Two identical tuning forks give no beats. What happens when one of them is loaded with wax? Why?
(Do aik jaise tuning forks se beats nahi bante. Agar aik par wax laga di jaye to kya hoga? Kyun?)
blocks.explanation: Aik frequency ke forks aik saath bajne par aik khalis note dete hain. Wax se loaded fork ki frequency thori kam ho jati hai, frequencies mukhtalif ho jaati hain aur aawaz baari baari tez aur dheemi (beats) sunayi deti hai.

book_ref.quote: If they are sounded simultaneously, it will be difficult to differentiate the notes

blocks.prompt:
53 Tuning forks of 512 Hz and 506 Hz are sounded together. Find the number of beats per second and the time between two successive loud sounds.
(512 Hz aur 506 Hz ke tuning forks aik saath bajte hain. Fi second beats aur do lagataar oonchi aawazon ka darmiyani waqt nikalein.)
blocks.explanation:
Fi second beats = 512 − 506 = 6
Oonchi aawazon ka waqfa T = 1/6 ≈ 0.17 s

book_ref.quote: As the difference of the frequency of the two tuning forks is also 4 Hz

blocks.prompt:
54 How are beats used to tune a string instrument?
(Beats ki madad se taar wala saaz kaise tune kiya jata hai?)
blocks.explanation: String ka note maloom frequency ke note ke saath bajaya jata hai aur beats sunayi dete hain. String ko kasa ya dheela kiya jata hai jab tak beats band na hon; tab us ki frequency matloob frequency ke barabar hoti hai.

book_ref.quote: One can use beats to tune a string instrument, such as piano or violin

blocks.prompt:
55 What is beat frequency? How is it related to the time between two successive loud sounds?
(Beat frequency kya hai? Iska do lagataar oonchi aawazon ke waqfe se kya ta'alluq hai?)
blocks.explanation: Beat frequency f_beat dono waves ki frequencies ka farq hai. Agar T = t₂ − t₁ do lagataar oonchi aawazon ka waqfa ho to f_beat = 1/T.

book_ref.quote: The difference between the frequencies of the two waves is termed as beat frequency

blocks.prompt:
56 Differentiate between interference and beats.
(Interference aur beats mein farq bayan karein.)
blocks.explanation: Interference ke liye aik frequency; beats ke liye thori mukhtalif frequencies.

book_ref.quote: Superposition of two waves having the same frequency and travelling in the same direction

rows: Aik frequency, aik simt wali do waves ka superposition.
Thori mukhtalif frequencies, aik simt wali do waves ka superposition.
Mukhtalif jagahon par oonchi aur dheemi aawaz (path difference par munhasir).
Aik hi jagah waqt ke saath baari baari oonchi aur dheemi aawaz.
Shart: ΔS = nλ (constructive) ya (2n + 1)λ/2 (destructive).
Fi second beats = frequencies ka farq.

blocks.prompt:
57 Fork A of 480 Hz gives 5 beats per second with fork B. When A is loaded with wax, the beats increase. Find the frequency of B.
(480 Hz ka fork A fork B ke saath 5 beats fi second deta hai. A par wax lagane se beats barh jaate hain. B ki frequency nikalein.)
blocks.explanation: B = 480 ± 5 = 485 ya 475 Hz. Wax se A 480 Hz se kam ho jata hai. Agar B 475 Hz hota to beats kam hote; beats barhte hain, is liye B = 485 Hz.

book_ref.quote: Let us consider 259 Hz as correct answer

blocks.title: Wazahat
blocks.text: Wax hamesha fork ki frequency kam karti hai. Dekhein ke A ke kam hone se kis option mein farq barhta hai: 485 − (480 se kam) = 5 se zyada. Is liye beats barhna 485 Hz ki taraf ishara hai.

blocks.prompt:
58 Define intensity of a wave. Write its formula and SI unit.
(Wave ki intensity ki definition likhein. Formula aur SI unit bhi likhein.)
blocks.explanation:
Intensity progressive wave ke phailne ki simt mein fi unit area fi unit time muntaqil hone wali energy hai.
I = E/(A × t) = P/A; unit: W m⁻²

book_ref.quote: Intensity is defined as the amount of energy transmitted per unit area per unit time

blocks.prompt:
59 What is a progressive wave? Give two examples.
(Progressive wave kya hai? Do misalein dein.)
blocks.explanation: Progressive (chalti) wave medium mein aik simt mein chalti aur energy aik jagah se doosri jagah le jaati hai, stationary wave ke baraks. Misalein: paani ki waves, sound waves, light waves.

book_ref.quote: Examples of progressive waves include water waves, sound waves, light waves etc.

blocks.prompt:
60 Why is the intensity of a mechanical wave proportional to the square of its amplitude?
(Mechanical wave ki intensity us ke amplitude ke square ke mutanasib kyun hai?)
blocks.explanation: Mechanical waves mein energy zarraat ki kinetic aur potential energy ki shakal mein hoti hai aur us ki miqdaar unke displacement (amplitude) par munhasir hai. Is liye I ∝ A², ya I = kA² (Eq. 7.13); k wave aur medium par munhasir hai.

book_ref.quote: How much energy is stored depends upon the displacement (amplitude) of the particles from the mean position.

blocks.prompt:
61 Sunlight of intensity 800 W m⁻² falls on a solar panel of area 1.5 m² for 10 minutes. Find the energy received.
(800 W m⁻² intensity ki dhoop 1.5 m² area ke solar panel par 10 minute parti hai. Hasil hone wali energy nikalein.)

book_ref.quote: By definition, the intensity of a wave, is

blocks.prompt:
62 A small source emits 40 W of sound evenly in all directions. Find the intensity at 3.0 m.
(Aik chhota source 40 W sound har taraf yaksaan deta hai. 3.0 m par intensity nikalein.)

book_ref.quote: If the sound waves are spreading out evenly in all directions

blocks.prompt:
63 The amplitude of a wave increases from 2 mm to 5 mm in the same medium. By what factor does its intensity increase?
(Usi medium mein aik wave ka amplitude 2 mm se 5 mm ho jata hai. Intensity kitne guna barhti hai?)
blocks.explanation: I = kA², is liye I₂/I₁ = (5/2)² = 6.25. Intensity 6.25 guna ho jati hai.

book_ref.quote: Here 'k' is the constant of proportionality and depends upon the physical properties

blocks.prompt:
64 Why does increasing the volume of a song not change its pitch?
(Gaane ka volume barhane se us ki pitch kyun nahi badalti?)
blocks.explanation: Chalti wave ki frequency aur amplitude aik doosre se aazad hain. Volume barhane se amplitude barhta hai, jab ke pitch frequency par munhasir hai jo wahi rehti hai.

book_ref.quote: That is why you can turn up the volume of a song

blocks.prompt:
65 What is the Doppler effect? Give an everyday example.
(Doppler effect kya hai? Rozmarra ki aik misaal dein.)
blocks.explanation: Source aur observer ki nisbati harkat se waves ki frequency (pitch) mein zahiri tabdeeli. Misaal: platform ki taraf aate engine ki seeti oonchi aur door jaate ki neechi sunayi deti hai.

book_ref.quote: The apparent change in the frequency (or pitch) of waves due to the relative motion between the source and observer

blocks.prompt:
66 What is Doppler shift? Why is the wavelength shorter in front of an approaching source?
(Doppler shift kya hai? Qareeb aate source ke saamne wavelength chhoti kyun hoti hai?)
blocks.explanation: Doppler shift Δλ = uₛ/f source ki harkat se wavelength mein tabdeeli hai. Qareeb aate source ke saamne utni hi waves kam jagah mein aa jaati hain, is liye waves dab jaati hain: λ_C = (v − uₛ)/f.

book_ref.quote: Here Δλ is the decrease in wavelength in one second and is called Doppler shift.

blocks.prompt:
67 A siren of 500 Hz moves at 20 m s⁻¹ towards a stationary listener. Find the frequency heard (speed of sound 340 m s⁻¹).
(500 Hz ka siren 20 m s⁻¹ se thehre sunne wale ki taraf aata hai. Sunayi dene wali frequency nikalein (sound ki speed 340 m s⁻¹).)

book_ref.quote: When the source moves towards the stationary observer C with velocity uₛ

blocks.prompt:
68 The same siren (500 Hz) now moves away from the listener at 20 m s⁻¹. Find the frequency heard (speed of sound 340 m s⁻¹).
(Wahi siren (500 Hz) ab 20 m s⁻¹ se sunne wale se door jata hai. Sunayi dene wali frequency nikalein (sound ki speed 340 m s⁻¹).)

book_ref.quote: When the source moves away from the stationary observer D with velocity uₛ

blocks.prompt:
69 Differentiate between a source of sound moving towards and moving away from a stationary observer.
(Thehre observer ki taraf aate aur us se door jaate sound ke source mein farq bayan karein.)
blocks.explanation: Qareeb aata: waves dabti hain, frequency zyada. Door jata: waves phailti hain, frequency kam.

book_ref.quote: The wavelength observed by the observed D is then

rows: Waves dabti hain; wavelength kam.
Waves phailti hain; wavelength zyada.
λ_C = (v − uₛ)/f
λ_D = (v + uₛ)/f
f_C = [v/(v − uₛ)] f > f
f_D = [v/(v + uₛ)] f < f
Pitch oonchi.
Pitch neechi.

blocks.prompt:
70 How is a sonic shockwave formed by an aeroplane?
(Hawai jahaz se sonic shockwave kaise banti hai?)
blocks.explanation: Jahaz tez hote waqt hawa ko dhakel kar apne aage pressure ki deewar banata hai. Jab woh sound ki speed se aage nikalta hai to yeh pressure kashti ki lakeer ki tarah peeche reh kar sonic shockwave banata hai.

book_ref.quote: As a plane accelerates, it builds up a front of air pressure by pushing air in front of it.

blocks.prompt:
71 Differentiate between RADAR and SONAR.
(RADAR aur SONAR mein farq bayan karein.)
blocks.explanation: RADAR radio waves istemal karta hai; SONAR paani ke andar sound ki goonj.

book_ref.quote: SONAR is an acronym derived from "Sound Navigation And Ranging".

rows: RAdio Detection And Ranging.
Sound Navigation And Ranging.
Radio waves (electromagnetic) bhejta aur leta hai.
Sonic ya ultrasonic waves: paani ke andar sound ki goonj.
Jahazon ki oonchai aur speed; satellites ki speed.
Submarines ka pata, mine hunting, samandar ki gehraai.

blocks.prompt:
72 Differentiate between red shift and blue shift.
(Red shift aur blue shift mein farq bayan karein.)
blocks.explanation: Red shift door jaate sitare ki; blue shift qareeb aate sitare ki nishani hai.

book_ref.quote: In Astronomy, astronomers use the Doppler effect to calculate the speeds of distant stars and galaxies.

rows: Zameen se door jaate sitare dikhate hain.
Zameen ki taraf aate sitare dikhate hain.
Wavelength saakin haalat se lambi.
Wavelength saakin haalat se chhoti.
Spectrum laal sire ki taraf sarakta hai.
Spectrum neele sire ki taraf sarakta hai.

blocks.prompt:
73 How does a radar speed trap find the speed of a car?
(Radar speed trap gaari ki speed kaise maloom karta hai?)
blocks.explanation: Transmitter microwaves chhote bursts mein bhejta hai; har burst raaste ki gaari se reflect hota hai. Chalti gaari se reflection Doppler shift hota hai. Shift naap kar computer programme gaari ki speed nikalta hai.

book_ref.quote: Microwaves are emitted from a transmitter in short bursts.

blocks.prompt:
74 How do astronomers find the speed of a star using the Doppler effect?
(Falkiyat daan Doppler effect se sitare ki speed kaise maloom karte hain?)
blocks.explanation: Woh sitare ki roshni ke line spectrum ka laboratory source ki roshni se muqabla karte hain. Farq se Doppler shift aur us se sitare ki speed nikalti hai (red shift: door; blue shift: qareeb).

book_ref.quote: By comparing the line spectrum of light from the star with light from a laboratory source

blocks.prompt:
75 Give two uses of the Doppler shift other than RADAR and SONAR.
(RADAR aur SONAR ke ilawa Doppler shift ke do istemal likhein.)
blocks.explanation: (1) Satellite navigation: satellite ki velocity aur position maloom kar ke durust location. (2) Mausam mein Doppler radar: hawa ki velocity aur barish ke pattern.

book_ref.quote: Satellite Navigation uses Doppler shift to determine satellite velocity and position

blocks.prompt:
76 A spectral line measured as 656 nm in the laboratory is observed at 650 nm in the light of a star. Is the star moving towards or away from the Earth? Give reason.
(Lab mein 656 nm wali spectral line aik sitare ki roshni mein 650 nm par milti hai. Sitara Zameen ki taraf aa raha hai ya door ja raha hai? Wajah dein.)
blocks.explanation: λ′ = 650 nm < λ = 656 nm, is liye f′ > f: blue shift. Sitara Zameen ki taraf aa raha hai.

book_ref.quote: ∵ λ′ > λ or f′ < f ∴ The galaxy is moving away from the Earth.
